youtube.aciklama: In vestibular migraine, attacks do not always come with headache; some attacks have no headache at all. A definite diagnosis requires a migraine history and at least five moderate or severe vestibular episodes lasting 5 minutes to 72 hours, with at least half accompanied by a migraine feature: headache, sensitivity to light and sound, or visual aura. Diagnosis and treatment decisions belong to the physician.
